test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the jumbled words and choose the alternative that correctly matches the given sentence.

The people of _______ to survive.

are / this / island / commodities / deprived / essential / needed / remote / of

options.text: remote island are deprived of essential commodities needed this
this remote island are needed essential commodities deprived of
this island are deprived of essential commodities needed remote
this remote island are deprived of essential commodities needed

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **this remote island are deprived of essential commodities needed**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence starts with the phrase "this remote island," correctly indicated by **part (this remote island).**
 
• Following the subject, "are deprived of essential commodities," continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the people are deprived of.
 
• The sentence ends with "needed" which completes the sentence by stating what the essential commodities are needed for.

Therefore, the correct answer is **this remote island are deprived of essential commodities needed.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** This option starts with "remote island are deprived of essential commodities needed this," which is grammatically incorrect and does not make logical sense.
 
• **Option 2:** This option starts with "this remote island are needed essential commodities deprived of," which creates a fragmented sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** This option starts with "this island are deprived of essential commodities needed remote," which is not structured correctly.
